title: A Schoolgirl Dodged A Train By Leaping Through Time, And It Cost Her The Boy She Loved . . .
caption:
Makoto Konno survives a train crash by leaping through time in The Girl Who Leapt Through Time. 😱 One girl, one strange power, and a summer that changes everything.

#thegirlwholeaptthroughtime #anime #animemovie #animerecap #fyp
comment: Would you have used your last leap to save Kosuke, or saved it for yourself? Why?
credit: Anime: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time (2006)

segments.say: A schoolgirl flies off her bike, and a speeding train comes straight at her, and nobody can *stop* it.
To see how it got here, go back to one ordinary *morning* in July.
Makoto Kono oversleeps again, and her little sister cannot *wake* her up, no matter how hard she tries.
So she jumps on her bike and races to *school*, late as always, with her bag flapping behind her.
Her two best friends, Chiaki and Kosuke, wait for her every day to play *catch*.
One afternoon, Makoto carries a stack of notebooks up to the science *lab*, all by herself.
Suddenly she hears a noise, as if someone is hiding *inside*.
On the floor, she spots a strange little *walnut*, rolling in a patch of sunlight.
She trips over it, and the whole room turns *white*.
Her body drops through a tunnel of light and *time*, spinning like a leaf.
She wakes up on the lab floor, dizzy and *confused*, with no idea what just happened.
Her friends laugh it off, then drag her out to play *catch*, as if nothing happened.
Soon she heads home on her bike, and then her brakes give *out*, right on a steep hill.
She squeezes the brakes with all her strength, but nothing *happens*, and the bike keeps speeding up.
Ahead of her, the railway crossing lights flash *red*, and a train is rushing in.
She is thrown from her bike, high into the air, straight toward the *train*.
Her whole life flashes before her eyes, and she thinks this is the *end*.
Then everything goes black, and she is sitting in the *road*, wide awake.
The train screams past, and Makoto is *alive*.
She was seconds from death, and now she has only a few *bruises*.
Confused, she runs to her aunt, the one everyone calls *Auntie Witch*.
Makoto spills the whole story, while her aunt calmly bites into a *peach*.

segments.text: What you experienced was a time leap.

segments.say: Her aunt says she did not go back in time. She jumped *through* it.
That night, her little sister thinks she is trying to die, and begs her to *stop*.
Makoto runs to the river, and tests it, running as hard as she *can*.
She launches off the ground, and the world around her *warps*.
She lands back in her house, a whole day *earlier*.
The pudding her sister ate is sitting in the fridge, *untouched*, and Makoto cannot believe her luck.
Makoto grins. She can leap through time, and nobody else *knows*.
So she uses it for everything. Karaoke, again and *again*. Very responsible.
She leaps back to eat dinner *twice*, and to catch every ball her friends throw.
Nobody told her every leap has a *price*.
Then her best friend Chiaki suddenly asks her to go *out* with him.
Makoto panics, does not want to ruin the friendship, and leaps *back* to before he said it.
This time she dodges him, and the confession never *happens*.
Three girls from the volunteer club corner Makoto and ask if she is dating *Kosuke*.
Makoto keeps leaping to patch things up, and the number on her arm keeps *dropping*.
She has no idea what the number even *means*.
Then Kosuke borrows her broken bike, and rides off with a girl on the *back*.
Makoto knows the brakes will fail, so she sprints toward the *tracks*, as fast as she can.
She calls Chiaki for help, but he asks her one strange *question*.
Makoto freezes. Chiaki knows her secret, and the number on her arm is *zero*.
With no leaps left, Makoto can only chase them and *scream*, but the crash is already happening.
Then time snaps back, and Chiaki is standing in the crowd right in front of *her*.
He tells her the truth. He is from the *future*.
He came all this way just to see one painting, one the future *lost*.
But he spent his last leap saving Kosuke, so he cannot go *home*.
He should have left weeks ago, but he loved being with his *friends*.
Then he is gone, and Makoto cannot find him in the *crowd*.
At school, the rumors fly, and everyone has a different *story*.
Makoto blames herself for never taking his words *seriously*.
Her aunt tells her about a love she lost to bad *timing*.
If a boy is late, her aunt says, you go and *find* him.
Makoto looks at her arm one last time. The number reads *one*.
She still has one leap left, and she runs out into the *night*.
She dives into the light, and her whole summer with Chiaki flashes *by*.
She lands in the lab, right before everything *began*.
She finds the strange walnut and holds it in her *hand*.
She races to the field, where Chiaki waits *alone*.
She hands him the walnut and tells him she knows everything about *him*.

segments.text: About how you came here from the future.

segments.say: Makoto promises to protect the painting, so he can see it in his *time*.
Chiaki says he will wait for her in the *future*.
Makoto smiles through her tears and promises to come *running*.
He ruffles her hair and *vanishes* into the sky.
Makoto goes back to the field and smiles up at the *sky*.
Someday, she will run all the way to the *future* to find him.
